title: ForTress: Bringing Assurance and Determinism for LLM-Driven Fortran-to-Python Translation
title_zh: ForTress：为LLM驱动的Fortran到Python翻译带来保障与确定性

paragraphs.en: 总结：ForTress通过可执行规则与Lean形式化审计，为LLM驱动的Fortran到Python翻译提供确定性复用和语义保证。 Modernizing mature scientific software from Fortran to Python can improve accessibility and integration with modern computing tools, but manual rewriting is expensive. Large language models (LLMs) make translation more practical, yet generated code can pass regression tests while violating source-language semantics, and contextual corrections may not persist across subsequent translations. We present ForTress, which solidifies recurring LLM translation decisions into guarded executable rules for deterministic reuse and provides semantic assurance for a non-trivial subset of these rules. Its LLM-assisted auditing process expresses universally quantified preservation obligations over mechanized Fortran and Python semantics in Lean. Human experts review semantic fidelity and correspondence with production rules, and Lean's kernel checks proofs and refutations under explicit assumptions. These audit records expose the conditions either supporting correctness or identifying failure cases. We evaluate ForTress on 17 benchmarks from 15 scientific software spanning diverse domains. The translated programs achieve bitwise-identical with native Fortran on all evaluated tests under the recorded execution and initialization configurations. Against these software, ForTress accumulates 193 executable rules and 188 audit records, of which 121 have checked soundness proofs, including 31 established after counterexample-guided refinement. Cross-software reuse exceeds 90% for 14 of the 15 software. Even with additional assurance and determinism, the LLM usage cost is 44.2% lower than direct LLM translation.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：ForTress通过可执行规则与Lean形式化审计，为LLM驱动的Fortran到Python翻译提供确定性复用和语义保证。 将成熟的科学软件从Fortran现代化迁移到Python可以提高其可访问性以及与现代计算工具的集成度，但手动重写成本高昂。 大语言模型（LLM）使翻译更加实用，但生成的代码可能通过回归测试的同时却违反源语言语义，而且上下文修正可能无法在后续翻译中持续保留。 我们提出ForTress，它将反复出现的LLM翻译决策固化为受保护的可执行规则以实现确定性复用，并为这些规则中一个非平凡的子集提供语义保证。 其LLM辅助的审计过程在Lean中对机械化的Fortran和Python语义表达全称量化的保持义务。 人类专家审查语义保真度以及与生产规则的对应关系，Lean内核在显式假设下检查证明与反驳。 这些审计记录揭示了支持正确性的条件或识别出的失败案例。 我们在来自15个科学软件、覆盖多个领域的17个基准上评估ForTress。 在记录的执行和初始化配置下，翻译后的程序在所有评估测试中与原生Fortran实现逐位一致。 针对这些软件，ForTress累积了193条可执行规则和188条审计记录，其中121条具有已验证的可靠性证明，包括31条在反例引导的精化之后建立的证明。 15个软件中有14个的跨软件复用率超过90%。 即使增加了额外保证和确定性，LLM使用成本仍比直接LLM翻译低44.2%。
